title: LUMEN
prompt: Most lamps have one setting | Cool and bright to think | Warm and low to stop | LUMEN - light that knows the hour
style: clean modern product photography, soft diffused daylight, shallow depth of field, matte surfaces, muted natural palette, minimal composition, crisp focus, high detail
line: Most desk lamps have one setting: on. LUMEN moves with the day. Cool and bright when you need to think. Warm and low when you need to stop. LUMEN. Light that knows what time it is.
